steps.what: List the stored amount for cashier's checks
Prepare cashier's checks from that stored amount
Verify cashier's checks before they are issued
Sign the cashier check amount
Issue only the signed cashier check
outputs: filed copy of signed cashier check v1

tasks.design: A job lists the stored amount in {BANK}. The teller prepares and verifies the cashier's checks. A later job issues only the signed check. It does not issue an unsigned amount.
tasks.previous_blocker: The amount was retyped onto the check.
tasks.enabler_now: Payee and amount are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The teller still verifies the check.
tasks.human_edge: The teller decides the amount to issue.
tasks.altitude: The teller spends the week on the check, not on listing the amount.

reach.task: Take only the check the teller signed

evidence.claim: The executive digest says a person keeps persuading and the payment release.
The executive digest says most of these figures are arithmetic on records, and interest charges are configuration or plain code.

assumptions: Payee, amount, and account identifier are stored on the payment record. The payment record produces them. A blank amount stays blank and is not issued.
Native configuration of the payment record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the teller signed is filed or sent.
The issue is the signed amount and no other amount.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining preparation is still the teller preparing the cashier's checks.

incremental.description: Refresh payee and amount when the payment layout changes, and drop a check the teller has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many amounts are blank. The high end assumes payee and amount are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List term deposits and night deposits to process
Process retirement savings plan contributions
Process automated teller transactions and mail deposits
Sign the deposit set
Post only the signed deposit set
outputs: filed copy of signed deposit set v1

tasks.design: A job lists term deposits and night deposits in {BANK}. The teller processes retirement savings contributions, automated teller transactions, and mail deposits. A later job posts only the signed set. It does not post an unsigned deposit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each deposit type was rekeyed into the ledger.
tasks.enabler_now: Deposit identifier, type, and amount are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The teller still accepts the deposit.
tasks.human_edge: The teller decides which set is ready.
tasks.altitude: The teller spends the week on the deposit, not on listing the types.

reach.task: Keep only the deposit the teller signed

evidence.claim: The executive digest says a person keeps persuading and the payment release.
The executive digest says most of these figures are arithmetic on records, and interest charges are configuration or plain code.

assumptions: Deposit identifier, type, amount, and value date are stored on the deposit record. The deposit record produces them. A blank amount stays blank and is not posted.
Native configuration of the deposit record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the teller signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining work is still the teller processing the contributions.

incremental.description: Refresh deposit identifier, type, and amount when the deposit layout changes, and drop a set the teller has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many deposit amounts are blank. The high end assumes deposit identifier, type, and amount are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List a stored answer for customers' questions
Answer telephones and assist customers
Judge whether it answers the customers' questions
Sign the call note
File the signed call note
outputs: filed copy of signed call note v1

tasks.design: A job lists a stored answer in {TELEPHONY}. The teller answers the telephones and assists the customers. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}. It is not an answer desk that speaks for itself, and it does not send a message.
tasks.previous_blocker: Answers were searched during the call.
tasks.enabler_now: Question identifier and stored answer are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The call stays with the teller.
tasks.human_edge: The teller decides what to say.
tasks.altitude: The teller spends the week on the call, not on finding the stored answer.

reach.task: Hear the teller, not a stored line alone

evidence.claim: The executive digest says a person keeps persuading and the payment release.

assumptions: Question identifier and stored answer are stored on the answer record. The answer record produces them. A blank answer stays blank and is not spoken as if it were a reply.
Native configuration of the answer record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the teller signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining call is still the teller answering the telephone.

incremental.description: Refresh question identifier and stored answer when the answer table changes, and drop a note the teller has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many stored answers are blank. The high end assumes question identifier and stored answer are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Flag transactions where debits and credits differ
Identify transaction mistakes behind the flag
Decide the correction so both sides balance
Sign the balance correction
File the signed balance correction
outputs: filed copy of signed balance correction v1

tasks.design: A job in {ERP} flags transactions where debits and credits do not balance. The teller identifies the transaction mistakes and decides the correction. A later job files the signed correction in {DOCS}. It does not post the correction alone.
tasks.previous_blocker: The teller hunted the imbalance in a printout.
tasks.enabler_now: Transaction identifier, debit, and credit are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The teller still decides the mistake.
tasks.altitude: The teller spends the week on the mistake, not on searching the ledger.

reach.task: Post only the correction the teller signed

evidence.claim: The executive digest says most of these figures are arithmetic on records, and interest charges are configuration or plain code.
The executive digest says a match is posted only on an exact amount, and any miss stops with a person.

assumptions: Transaction identifier, debit, and credit are stored on the ledger record. The ledger record produces them. A blank side stays blank and is not treated as zero. The flag is a difference, not a posted correction.
Native configuration of the ledger record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the teller signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining review is still the teller identifying the mistakes.

incremental.description: Refresh transaction identifier, debit, and credit when the ledger layout changes, and drop a correction the teller has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many debit or credit amounts are blank. The high end assumes transaction identifier, debit, and credit are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The teller spends the week at the window, on the cash, and on the signed amount. A stored total, a fee from a stored rule, and filing that signature can move. The teller still counts the cash, checks the signature, and releases the payment.
reach: A customer receives only the amount the teller signed.
A colleague posts only the deposit the teller signed.
skills_to_grow: Reject a payout that the teller has not signed.
Reject a fee that does not match the stored rule.
Reject a balance that treats a blank amount as zero.
role.ambitious_version: A signed payout or statement can go out the same day, and the teller still owns the cash.
